objects.name: pricing_rules_admin_all
objects.definition: {"roles" : ["authenticated"], "cmd" : "ALL", "qual" : "( SELECT private.is_admin() AS is_admin)", "with_check" : "( SELECT private.is_admin() AS is_admin)"}

objects.name: pricing_rules_student_matching_select
objects.definition: {"roles" : ["authenticated"], "cmd" : "SELECT", "qual" : "((enabled = true) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1\n   FROM profiles p\n  WHERE ((p.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ((lecture_pricing_rules.academic_year IS NULL) OR (lecture_pricing_rules.academic_year = p.medical_year)) AND ((lecture_pricing_rules.nationality_match = '*'::text) OR (lower(lecture_pricing_rules.nationality_match) = lower(COALESCE(p.nationality, ''::text))) OR ((lecture_pricing_rules.nationality_match = 'NON_EGYPTIAN'::text) AND (lower(COALESCE(p.nationality, ''::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['egyptian'::text, 'egypt'::text]))))))))", "with_check" : null}

objects.name: audit_sensitive_change
objects.definition: CREATE TRIGGER audit_sensitive_change AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.lecture_pricing_rules FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.audit_sensitive_change()
